meta.title: Fotis Oikonomou | Full-stack Engineer (React/TypeScript · PHP/Laravel)
meta.description: Full-stack engineer in Athens with 10 years building web and mobile applications. Responsible for two nationwide production systems in Greece; most recently built frontend modules for Lithuania's national tax portal.

hero.lede: 10 years in web development, ~3 of them building production React, TypeScript and React Native applications. Full-stack background in PHP (Laravel, Yii, Joomla). In practice, that means I can take a feature from the database schema all the way to the button the user clicks, with no handoff.
hero.lede2: I've done both: been the only developer on a project and been one of twenty people on a team. What stays constant is that I think about the risks, technical and timeline, from the start and put them on the table early, so delivery holds no surprises.
hero.traceLabel: Decorative waveform that reacts to the pointer

about.title: About
about.currently: I hold a diploma in Byzantine music, and I'm building a classifier that listens to a hymn and works out which of the eight modes (echoi) it belongs, to Python and librosa for the analysis, React for the UI. It's the first project where my two fields of study genuinely need each other.
about.p1: I'm a full-stack engineer with 10 years in web development: about 3 of them building production applications with React, TypeScript and React Native, and the rest in backend/full-stack development with PHP (Laravel, Yii, Joomla).
about.p2: For nearly four years I was responsible for two production systems used across Greece: the Hellenic Coast Guard's incident-tracking system, used by every Port Authority in the country, and Safe Water Sports, a water-safety app for iOS and Android with 50,000 users. I took over the Coast Guard system with serious database problems. I stabilised it and then kept evolving it with new features, without disrupting its users.
about.p3: Most recently I worked in a large team, building frontend modules for SOLON, Lithuania's national tax portal.
about.p4: So I've done both: been the person who keeps a system running single-handedly, and a member of a large team on a national-scale project. Either way, I think early about what could go wrong and flag it before it becomes a problem.
about.p5: Available immediately for roles in Greece, remote, or with relocation.
